items.prompt: A UTF-8 CSV starts with field names and contains empty and repeated customer_id values. Which configuration and expected behavior match version 1.0?

options.C: Set header=false and make customer_id optional.

items.rationale: A follows I1. B invents ID generation; C misreads headers and required key; D contradicts duplicate rejection.

items.prompt: Complete an ingestion evidence sheet and publication recommendation for B-17.
items.setup: Synthetic paper case; no commands executed. Previous published P-16 remains available. UTF-8 CSV header customer_id,amount. Six data rows: 1 C101,10; 2 C102,20; 3 [empty],30; 4 C102,40; 5 C105,50; 6 C106,60. Supplied rejection report: row 3 empty key and row 4 duplicate key. Accepted=4, rejected=2. Configuration: header=true, customer_id required. Preview shows C101/10 and C105/50. Mapping log maps source amount to destination customer_name instead of amount. No exclusion agreed. Treat the report as authoritative about which duplicate row was rejected; do not invent duplicate semantics.
items.deliverable: One sheet with configuration/mapping findings, row accounting, rejection disposition/rerun plan and publication recommendation with evidence and escalation. Distinguish supplied evidence from proposed repairs.

rubric.anchor: 2: identifies appropriate header/key settings AND wrong amount mapping requiring correction; 1: only one; 0: neither or accepts mapping.
2: gives 4+2=6 and says count agreement alone does not authorize release; 1: correct arithmetic without release implication; 0: arithmetic wrong or says totals alone permit release.

2: addresses both invalid keys through correction with owner input or explicit agreed exclusion, then rerun/reconcile; 1: fully handles one or omits agreement/rerun; 0: silent exclusion or unchanged retry as repair.

2: holds pending corrected mapping/dispositions and representative recheck, retains source/reconciliation and previous version, escalates unresolved discrepancy to data owner; 1: holds with incomplete evidence/rechecks/escalation; 0: recommends publication now.

items.prompt: For Northstar 2.0, complete an access evidence sheet for svc-orders and a safe remediation sequence.
items.setup: Synthetic 2.0 paper case; no token supplied or changes executed. Requirement: read orders only. Current grant: workspace reader. A proposed replacement has workspace traverse only and no dataset query grant. Under the CURRENT broad grant, svc-orders orders read succeeds, orders write is denied, unrelated customer ledger read succeeds. An administrator read also succeeds. No tests of the proposed replacement have run. A service token was disclosed in a shared note, represented only as TOKEN_REDACTED.
items.deliverable: One sheet: exact grant replacement and explanation of each required component; interpretation of current results and proposed replacement; service-identity recheck plan; token response sequence; credential-free incident/evidence record. Separate proposed actions from supplied observations.

rubric.anchor: 2: removes broad workspace reader and specifies BOTH workspace traverse AND dataset orders query, explains traverse-only cannot read and query-only is insufficient, and identifies unrelated exposure; 1: proposes both narrow grants but omits removal or one explanation; 0: recommends either grant alone, removed dataset reader, broad reader, writer or administrator as sufficient.

2: identifies current ledger success as failure and requires service-identity orders read success, orders write denial and unrelated-data denial after BOTH replacement grants; 1: recognizes exposure but rechecks incomplete; 0: accepts administrator test or current results as verification of proposed replacement.
2: revokes disclosed token and gets authorized replacement; 1: only one; 0: rename/add token only or keep using disclosed token.

2: records identity, outcomes and incident/action status without secrets and labels proposed rechecks as proposed; 1: safe record with missing identity/status detail; 0: copies secret or falsely claims remediation happened.

items.rationale: 2.0 A1 changes remediation to two jointly necessary grants. A2 verification and A3 revocation/replacement remain required. Paper evidence planning does not demonstrate actual execution.
